name: PegBio Co., Ltd.
summary: PegBio Co., Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company researching and developing drugs for chronic diseases in China. Its candidates are PB-119, a GLP-1 receptor agonist aimed at type 2 diabetes and obesity, PB-718, a long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonist studied for NASH, and PB-1902, targeting an opioid receptor.
